checks.name: returning a lease permits reuse of the same database session
two checked-out leases use two different PostgreSQL sessions
pool capacity and acquisition deadline bound a third borrower
failed transactional lease returns without committing its partial write
ordinary pool return does not erase arbitrary session SET state
SET LOCAL request state expires at its transaction boundary
explicit reset callback clears the tested session setting

scope: Actual Psycopg pool and PostgreSQL sessions; no PgBouncer or load benchmark
